fact: A ministry letter of 7 May 2026, following letter 1931/26 of 6 May 2026, brings in daily, real-time digital recording of pupils' absences in lower secondary schools (the 'pioneer' collèges) through the 'Massar+ Administration' application: teaching staff record absences at the start of each lesson and the school's administration keys and validates them; it does not cover primary schools.
title: مراسلة وزارية بشأن تدبير الغياب اليومي والآني بإعداديات الريادة عبر منظومة "مسار+ إدارة"
